Name: Stripe Notification Service
Brief: A high-throughput push notification microservice handling 500k+ messages/day for Stripe users across iOS, Android, and Web.
Responsibilities: Designed the service in Go with a Kafka consumer pipeline. Implemented retry logic, dead-letter queue, and per-device rate limiting. Wrote internal benchmarks achieving <5ms p99 latency.

Name: Order Management System - Shopify
Brief: Core backend API for a B2B e-commerce order flow: cart, checkout, inventory reservation, invoicing.
Responsibilities: Built REST APIs with Spring Boot. Integrated Redis for session/cache. Wrote JUnit tests achieving 85% code coverage. Coordinated with frontend team on API contracts.

Name: go-taskq
Brief: Open-source lightweight task queue library for Go with support for multiple backends (Redis, PostgreSQL).
Responsibilities: Designed the public API, implemented workers, retry strategies, and backoff. Published on GitHub with documentation and example apps. 200+ GitHub stars.

Name: Internal Developer Platform - Stripe
Brief: Built a self-service Kubernetes platform for 50+ engineers, abstracting cluster operations behind a GitOps workflow.
Responsibilities: Set up AWS EKS clusters with Terraform. Deployed ArgoCD for GitOps. Wrote Helm chart templates for standardized service deployments. Reduced onboarding time for new services from 3 days to 2 hours.

Name: Observability Stack Migration
Brief: Migrated monitoring from CloudWatch to a self-hosted Prometheus + Grafana + Alertmanager stack, covering 20+ microservices.
Responsibilities: Designed recording rules and alerting policies. Integrated Datadog for APM traces. Created runbook documentation and on-call playbooks.

Name: k8s-cost-exporter
Brief: Open-source Prometheus exporter that surfaces per-namespace AWS cost allocation data from Cost Explorer API.
Responsibilities: Built in Python with the official Prometheus client. Packaged as a Docker image with Helm chart. Featured in CNCF newsletter.

Name: Legacy Portfolio Site
Brief: Old personal portfolio website built early in career, replaced by a newer version.
Responsibilities: Built a static portfolio site with HTML/CSS/jQuery, no longer maintained.

Name: Rate Limiter Middleware
Brief: Reusable HTTP middleware that enforces per-client rate limits using a token-bucket algorithm backed by Redis, protecting internal APIs from abusive traffic.
Responsibilities: Implemented token-bucket and sliding-window strategies in Go. Added configurable limits per API key and route. Exposed Prometheus metrics for throttled requests. Wrote load tests confirming under 1ms overhead per request.

Name: gRPC Gateway POC
Brief: Proof of concept for exposing internal gRPC services as REST/JSON endpoints through a single gateway, evaluated as a replacement for hand-written BFF adapters.
Responsibilities: Configured grpc-gateway with protobuf annotations and generated OpenAPI specs. Added JWT authentication and request logging interceptors. Benchmarked against the existing adapters and presented the results to the architecture group.

Name: Feature Flag Service
Brief: Centralized feature flag service that lets teams roll out changes gradually with percentage-based targeting and instant kill switches.
Responsibilities: Built the flag evaluation API in Go with PostgreSQL storage and an in-memory cache. Implemented user-segment targeting and audit logging. Provided client SDKs for Go and Java. Reduced rollback time for risky releases from hours to seconds.

Name: Internal CLI Toolkit
Brief: Command-line toolkit that bundles everyday developer tasks such as environment setup, log tailing, and secret lookup into a single binary.
Responsibilities: Developed subcommands with Cobra in Go. Added shell autocompletion and configuration profiles per environment. Wrote documentation and automated releases with GoReleaser.

Name: Log Aggregation Pipeline
Brief: Centralized logging pipeline that collects structured logs from 30+ services into Elasticsearch for search, dashboards, and alerting.
Responsibilities: Deployed Fluent Bit as a DaemonSet and configured parsing and enrichment rules. Sized and tuned Elasticsearch indices with lifecycle policies. Built Kibana dashboards for the on-call team. Cut log storage costs by 35% through retention tiering.

Name: Blue/Green Deploy Tool
Brief: Deployment tool that automates blue/green releases on Kubernetes with health-check gating and one-command rollback.
Responsibilities: Wrote the orchestration logic in Go using the Kubernetes client library. Integrated smoke tests and traffic switching via Istio virtual services. Documented the release process and trained three teams to adopt it.

Name: Secrets Rotation Job
Brief: Scheduled job that rotates database credentials and API keys stored in AWS Secrets Manager without service downtime.
Responsibilities: Implemented rotation Lambda functions in Python for PostgreSQL and third-party API credentials. Added a dual-credential overlap window and automated verification. Set up alerts for failed rotations and reached 100% compliance with the 90-day rotation policy.

Name: Multi-Region Failover Runbook Automation
Brief: Automation that turns the manual multi-region failover runbook into a tested, repeatable workflow with clear go/no-go checks.
Responsibilities: Scripted DNS, database promotion, and traffic-shifting steps with Terraform and Python. Added pre-flight validation and rollback stages. Ran quarterly game-day drills that brought failover time down from 40 minutes to 9.

Name: GraphQL BFF Layer
Brief: Backend-for-frontend layer that aggregates multiple REST microservices behind a single GraphQL schema for web and mobile clients.
Responsibilities: Designed the schema and resolvers with Apollo Server and TypeScript. Added DataLoader batching to eliminate N+1 calls. Implemented persisted queries and field-level caching. Reduced mobile payload size by roughly 45%.

Name: Event Sourcing Experiment
Brief: Side project exploring event sourcing and CQRS by modeling an order lifecycle with an append-only event store and projected read models.
Responsibilities: Built the event store on PostgreSQL and the projections in Go. Implemented snapshotting and idempotent event handlers. Documented trade-offs and lessons learned in a public write-up.

Name: Chaos Engineering Suite
Brief: Set of fault-injection experiments that validate critical services survive pod failures, network latency, and dependency outages.
Responsibilities: Authored experiments with Chaos Mesh and LitmusChaos. Defined steady-state hypotheses tied to SLOs. Ran monthly game days and filed fixes for 12 resilience gaps discovered.

Name: Cost Anomaly Detector
Brief: Service that detects unusual cloud spend by comparing daily AWS cost data against a rolling baseline and alerting owners on Slack.
Responsibilities: Ingested Cost Explorer data into a time-series store using Python. Implemented z-score anomaly detection with per-team thresholds. Sent Slack alerts linking to the responsible resources. Caught a misconfigured autoscaler that would have cost around USD 6k per month.

Name: Static Site Generator Rewrite
Brief: Personal rewrite of a static site generator in Rust, focused on fast incremental builds for Markdown-based documentation sites.
Responsibilities: Implemented Markdown parsing, templating, and a file watcher for incremental rebuilds. Added syntax highlighting and RSS feed generation. Achieved full rebuilds of 1,000 pages in under 2 seconds.

Name: Slack Ops Bot
Brief: Slack bot that lets engineers check service status, trigger deployments, and page the on-call engineer without leaving chat.
Responsibilities: Built slash commands in Node.js with the Slack Bolt framework. Integrated the PagerDuty and CI system APIs. Added role-based permissions and audit logging of every command.

Name: Terraform Module Library
Brief: Collection of reusable Terraform modules for common AWS building blocks such as VPCs, ECS clusters, and RDS instances.
Responsibilities: Authored and versioned the modules with input validation and example configurations. Wrote README documentation and basic integration tests.

Name: Synthetic Monitoring Suite
Brief: Synthetic monitoring scripts that probe critical user journeys and public endpoints every minute from multiple regions.
Responsibilities: Wrote probe scripts in Python and scheduled them with cron and AWS Lambda. Pushed results to Graphite and configured alert thresholds.

Name: Canary Analysis Tool
Brief: Tool that compares metrics between canary and baseline deployments to decide whether a rollout should continue.
Responsibilities: Implemented statistical comparison of error rate and latency in Python. Integrated with Jenkins pipelines to promote or abort releases automatically.

Name: Data Retention Cleanup Job
Brief: Scheduled job that purges expired customer data from production databases to satisfy retention and privacy policies.
Responsibilities: Wrote batched delete jobs in Java with configurable retention windows per table. Added a dry-run mode and reporting of rows removed.

Name: Webhook Delivery Service
Brief: Service that delivers event webhooks to customer endpoints with signed payloads, retries, and delivery logs.
Responsibilities: Implemented HMAC signing and exponential backoff retries in Go. Stored delivery attempts in PostgreSQL and exposed a replay endpoint.

Name: CLI Password Manager
Brief: Personal command-line password manager that keeps an encrypted local vault with quick clipboard copy and password generation.
Responsibilities: Implemented AES-256 encryption with a key derived from the master password using Argon2. Added a password generator, tagging, and export/import commands.

Name: Personal Budget Tracker
Brief: Small web app for logging daily expenses and visualizing monthly spending by category.
Responsibilities: Built the interface with jQuery and Chart.js on top of a simple PHP and MySQL backend. Added CSV import for bank statements.

Name: Recipe Sharing App
Brief: Web app where friends can share recipes, tag ingredients, and build weekly shopping lists.
Responsibilities: Developed the Django backend with user authentication and image uploads. Created the responsive front end with Bootstrap. Deployed to Heroku.

Name: Markdown Note Sync Tool
Brief: Utility that syncs a local folder of Markdown notes with cloud storage and keeps a searchable index.
Responsibilities: Wrote the sync logic in Node.js with file watching and conflict detection. Added full-text search using SQLite FTS.

Name: Pomodoro Timer App
Brief: Desktop Pomodoro timer that tracks focus sessions and shows weekly productivity statistics.
Responsibilities: Built the app with Electron and React. Added system notifications, custom session lengths, and local storage of session history.

Name: Weather Dashboard Widget
Brief: Embeddable widget that displays current conditions and a five-day forecast for a chosen city.
Responsibilities: Consumed the OpenWeatherMap API with vanilla JavaScript. Implemented response caching to stay within free-tier limits and added light and dark themes.

Name: URL Shortener
Brief: Minimal URL shortening service with custom aliases and click analytics.
Responsibilities: Implemented the API in Go with Redis for lookups and PostgreSQL for analytics. Added basic rate limiting and a simple admin page.

Name: Old jQuery Plugin Collection
Brief: Small set of jQuery plugins for common UI needs such as image sliders, form validation, and tooltips.
Responsibilities: Wrote and documented each plugin and published them on GitHub. Tested behavior across the major browsers of the time.

Name: Legacy PHP CMS Plugin
Brief: WordPress plugin that adds a customizable event calendar with category filters to small business websites.
Responsibilities: Developed the plugin in PHP using custom post types and shortcodes. Built the admin settings pages and kept it compatible with new WordPress releases.

Name: Deprecated REST Wrapper
Brief: Client library wrapping a third-party payment provider's REST API with typed models and retry handling.
Responsibilities: Implemented the wrapper in Java with OkHttp and Jackson. Added unit tests with mocked responses and published the library to a private Maven repository.

Name: Abandoned Chrome Extension
Brief: Browser extension that saves highlighted text from web pages into a personal reading list.
Responsibilities: Built the extension in JavaScript using the Manifest V2 API. Added tagging and export to Markdown.

Name: Early Django Blog Engine
Brief: Custom blog engine with Markdown posts, tagging, and an RSS feed, built while learning Django.
Responsibilities: Modeled posts and comments with the Django ORM. Implemented an admin workflow and deployed on a VPS with Nginx and Gunicorn.

Name: Unfinished Game Jam Project
Brief: Two-dimensional puzzle platformer started during a game jam and later paused before completion.
Responsibilities: Programmed player movement and level loading in Unity with C#. Designed three playable levels and integrated basic sound effects.

Name: Old College Capstone App
Brief: Capstone project: a web system for managing student club events and registrations, usable on mobile browsers.
Responsibilities: Developed the backend with Java Servlets and MySQL. Presented the final demo to the faculty panel.

Name: Discontinued Slack Bot
Brief: Slack bot that posts daily stand-up reminders and collects team status updates.
Responsibilities: Implemented the bot in Python using the Slack RTM API. Stored responses in SQLite and generated a daily summary message.

Name: Retired Internal Wiki Tool
Brief: Lightweight internal wiki for a small team with page versioning and full-text search.
Responsibilities: Built the application with Flask and PostgreSQL. Added Markdown editing, page history, and simple role-based access.

Name: Sunset Analytics Dashboard
Brief: Dashboard that visualizes product usage metrics such as daily active users and feature adoption.
Responsibilities: Created ETL scripts in Python that load data into PostgreSQL. Built charts with D3.js and scheduled nightly refreshes.

Name: Archived Hackathon Prototype
Brief: Hackathon prototype for a carpooling matcher that pairs commuters by route and schedule.
Responsibilities: Built the matching algorithm and REST API in Node.js during a 48-hour event. Presented the demo together with a team of three.

Name: Old Terraform POC
Brief: Proof of concept evaluating Terraform for provisioning a small AWS environment from scratch.
Responsibilities: Codified VPC, EC2, and RDS resources with remote state in S3. Documented findings and compared the approach with CloudFormation.
